content.text:
If you mean the **old Spiegel catalog / Spiegel home shopping**: Spiegel as a major U.S. catalog retailer is **not operating today as the classic online catalog store** in the way Sears/Ward-style catalogs once did. It was historically a catalog retailer selling apparel, home furnishings, housewares, and more. ([encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/economics/economics-magazines/spiegel-group?utm_source=openai))

If you’re trying to **shop for home items online**, you may want alternatives like:

- **Wayfair** – furniture, décor, rugs, lighting
- **Amazon Home**
- **Walmart Home**
- **Target Home**
- **Home Depot / Lowe’s** – home improvement + furnishings
- **IKEA**
- **Overstock / Bed Bath & Beyond**
- **Pottery Barn / West Elm** – higher-end décor

If you meant **“Spiegel” as in mirrors** — the German word *Spiegel* means “mirror” — online mirror-shopping results include stores such as home24, Westwing, Höffner, and ROLLER. ([home24.at](https://www.home24.at/alle-spiegel/?utm_source=openai))
